Design leadership

Experience, without the excess.

“A good space should feel inevitable—clear in its movement, honest in its materials and personal in its details.”

Led by principal designer Mr. Samir, the studio brings more than 21 years of design experience to each commission. The approach balances disciplined planning with a close reading of how clients live, work and gather.

Principal-led from brief to handover.
Transparent process

Designed in the open.

Clear decisions, visible milestones and one continuous line of thought from first conversation to final styling.
